name: Road distance to a supermarket (estimate, km)
plain: How far residents live from the nearest supermarket, along the roads, on average.
definition: The average road distance from where the area's residents live to the nearest supermarket, in kilometres, each 2020 Census block weighted by its residents. Supermarkets are Overture's grocery and warehouse-club places whose name is a supermarket's ("supermercado", "supermarket" or a supermarket chain), plus Walmart, Costco and Sam's Club, and OpenStreetMap's supermarkets that Overture lacks; corner stores (colmados) are left out. An estimate: distance along the mapped roads in either direction, not a driving route or a time. The places come from a directory, so a shop that closed may still be counted and one that opened may be missing. Blocks with no road within 2 km, or no road to any place of the kind, are left out.

coverage.frequency: Rebuilt by hand with python essentials.py --refresh (Overture release 2026-10-21.0, OpenStreetMap extract of 2026-11-17).

method: essentials.py searches the road graph the map uses (roads.bin, from OpenStreetMap) outward from every place of a kind at once, in both directions of every road (one-way streets are read as two-way: a distance, not a driving route). Each 2020 Census block with residents is snapped to the nearest road joined to the network within 2 km; its distance is the road distance to the nearest place, plus the straight lines from the block and the place to their roads. A barrio's or municipio's figure is the average over its residents. Shops come from Overture's places (confidence 0.5 or more) and OpenStreetMap's that Overture lacks; libraries and fire stations from the map's own layers, with OpenStreetMap's fire stations that USGS lacks. No time is estimated and no traffic is assumed.
source_detail: Estimated by the observatory: road distance over the OpenStreetMap road graph (roads.bin) from each 2020 Census block with residents to the nearest point of the kind, averaged over residents (essentials.py)
how_to_read: Puerto Rico: 2.81 km on average (half of residents 1.97 km or less). Farthest: Maricao (14.96 km), Comerío (8.69 km), Adjuntas (5.97 km). Barrios: half are 3.74 km or less, one in ten 9.66 km or more. Range: from Overture's 483 places alone the island figure is 2.94 km; with the 70 OpenStreetMap places Overture lacks, 2.81 km.
caveats: The places come from directories, not an inspection: a shop that closed may still be listed (the distance then reads shorter) and one that opened may be missing (longer).

Supermarket is a rule on the name ("supermercado", "supermarket" or a chain); in small towns the nearest food store is often a colmado that the rule leaves out: compare with the distance to any food store.
A road distance, not a travel time: it does not say whether people have a car, how often a bus passes or how steep the road is.
Check: of OpenStreetMap's places, 76.0% of 292 supermarkets, 87.1% of 387 pharmacies, 84.1% of 308 banks have an Overture place within 300 m.
